name: horizun-msproject-mcp
description: Audit, reschedule and author Microsoft Project schedules with a critical-path engine, DCMA-14 and verified writes. No Java, no Project install.

interface.shortDescription: Read, audit and reschedule Microsoft Project files
interface.longDescription: Open a Microsoft Project .mpp, a Primavera .xer or an MSPDI .xml and ask where the critical path runs, who is overbooked, and whether the schedule would pass a DCMA audit. Reschedule against a target date, recover the logic a planner never linked, and write changes back — every write is re-read from the model before it is reported as applied. Runs without Java and without Microsoft Project installed.
defaultPrompt: Audit this schedule against DCMA-14 and tell me what would fail.
Which tasks are late, and what is the earliest finish I can still hit?
This schedule has almost no links — recover the logic its dates already imply.
